body_text:
If $V$ is finite-dimensional and $U,W\leq V$, then
$\dim(U+W)+\dim(U\cap W)=\dim U+\dim W$. For a direct sum this
reduces to $\dim(U\oplus W)=\dim U+\dim W$.
